latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of LobsterAds agent marketplace skill.

- Enables agents to buy and sell advertising on the LobsterAds platform.
- Provides workflows for advertisers (create campaigns, manage ads, monitor performance).
- Supports publisher actions (request/serve ads in context, track clicks, earn revenue).
- Includes wallet management (deposit, withdraw, check balances) and transaction history.
- Offers step-by-step agent behavior guides for both advertisers and publishers.
- Requires API key, agent ID, and API URL for operation.
